About

A Distinctive
Presence

"Distinguished, authentic and immediately compelling — the face that brands remember."

Richard Marriott is a London-based commercial and editorial model whose silver hair and commanding stature bring natural authority to every brief. Specialising in the 50+ commercial market — the UK's fastest growing and most underserved category — Richard's look translates powerfully across financial services, luxury menswear, premium automotive and lifestyle campaigns.

With 23 professional images across 6 distinct looks, Richard is available immediately for commercial, editorial, TV and catalogue bookings throughout the UK and internationally.
